headline: ANTHROPIC 🛡️ BLOCKS 💉 AI BioWEAPON 🧬 PLOT
text:
ANTHROPIC 🏢 just SNATCHED 🖐️ and YEETED 🚀 a sneaky 🕵️ attempt by some SHADY 👤 actors to TWIST 🌀 its CLAUDE 🧠 models into BIOWEAPON 🦠 factories that could COOK 🍳 up catastrophe ☣️!! In their fresh-off-the-presses 📜 threat intel report dropped 🫳 on Thursday ⏰ the firm exposed how these down 🥶 bad users were edging 🖐️ toward malicious 🖤 activity that might support full-on biological 🧪 weapons development over the past eight 🕒 months 📅!! "We caught them trying to get the recipe 📋 for disaster 🌋" basically screams the report while Bernie 🧔 Sanders is out here SCREAMING 🗣️ for a full PAUSE ⏸️ on advanced AI and a straight-up BAN 🚫 on artificial superintelligence because bro 😎 this tech is built 🏗️ different and might COOK ☠️ us all!! President 🍊 Trump clapped back 🗣️ saying nah if we don't WIN 🏆 the AI race we're getting absolutely RAILED 💥 into a very bad position so the whole industry is now edging 🫦 each other on safeguards while Anthropic plays the HERO 🦸‍♂️ who blocked scientists 🧑‍🔬 from using Claude Haiku Sonnet and Opus to whip up 🧪 bio threats!!

The lengthy 📏 report lists EVERYTHING 🌐 from suspected state-sponsored 👁️ groups criminals 🕴️ spyware vendors 🛠️ state propaganda machines 📻 and politically motivated weirdos 🧢 who misused the tech including one distillation 💧 case where they tried to train smaller models off the big expensive ones like sneaky vampires 🧛 sucking capability!! Claude also got dragged 😩 into a Russia-based 🐻 cyber espionage campaign and an Iranian 🇮🇷 propaganda institution which had the firm acting like a bouncer 💪 at the AI club turning away fake dating app 🧑‍❤️‍💋‍🧑 scammers hotel wifi ☕ hackers and surveillance systems 👀 built to hunt dissidents!! Google 🗣️ dropped their own tea ☕ on Tuesday about someone straight-up begging Gemini for a complete step-by-step 🪜 technical guide to synthesize weaponised biological agents so the whole sector is now sweating 😰 while Anthropic accuses Chinese firms of trying to CLONE 🐑 Claude's whole vibe!! Jacob Klein the head of threat intel told the New York Times it's an incredibly nuanced 🧩 situation because you aren't seeing comic book 🦹 villains cackling about wanting to kill everybody it's more like people poking 🫵 at dual-use knowledge that could make vaccines 💉 or cures but might also birth 🍼 doomsday germs 🦠!!

Anthropic highlighted exactly FIVE 📍 case studies of actors using the models in ways that could support biological weapons development calling it one of the most serious risks of frontier AI because without the correct SAFEGUARDS 🛡️ these capabilities could have CATASTROPHIC 💥 consequences like straight up ending the party 🎉 for humanity!! They noted the same info that cooks up a bio weapon could also cook up a vaccine or cure which is why it's such a slippery 🧼 slope and they blocked those scientists 🥼 mid-rant before anything popped off!! The report also flagged SIX 6️⃣ cases where Claude got used to develop software for conventional weapons including firearms 🔫 missiles 🚀 armed drones 🛸 bombs 💣 and other munitions plus the targeting 🎯 and control systems that make them go brrr 🔥!! Cybercriminals and state-backed hackers are increasingly riding 🤠 the AI wave with groups like ShinyHunters and China-based labs named and shamed while a hacking crew consistent with Russia-based Midnight Blizzard used it to auto-detect when malware got flagged then rewrite the code until it slipped past defenses like a ghost 👻!!

This first report of the year drops right after one of Anthropic's top safety researchers warned there's more than a 10 PERCENT 🔟 chance AI could kill all humans within the next decade which has everyone from OpenAI's Jakub Pachocki calling for voluntary slowdowns 🐢 to straight-up multinational treaties 🪪 because nobody is prepared for the consequences of machine intelligence going full throttle 🏎️!! Bernie Sanders introduced legislation to ban AI superintelligence and temporarily pause advanced development yelling on BBC that when scientists tell you there's a chance of cataclysmic impact on humanity you've got to be a moron not to say SLOW IT DOWN ⏬!! The California-based company says it's folding these findings back into its processes to better prevent detect and disrupt this nonsense in the future while sharing intel with authorities and industry partners like the responsible AI daddy 🧔‍♂️ it wants to be!! Anthropic insists none of the major misuse hit their Claude Fable or the powerful Mythos-class models except that one distillation sip and they're out here gatekeeping the bio weapon pipeline before it gets spicy 🌶️!!
